findings: Unexpected output from failed or successful legacy child was removed with scratch without being preserved or refusing acceptance.
The legacy checker accepted negative adapter wall time and reversed adapter timestamps when the derived envelope was consistent.
existing_attempt_assessment: These synthetic counterexamples establish validator gaps; they do not show that retained historical attempts lost extra outputs or have invalid timing.
remaining_authority: Coordinator must allocate and prospectively bind any new experiment/task/run and exact v2 source closure before execution; the original approved plans and source remain immutable.
preservation_failure_policy: Scratch is retained on output preservation failure; its location is recorded in the failure receipt. If receipt persistence also fails, stderr records the retained location. Cleanup occurs only after both output preservation and receipt persistence succeed.
